items.text: Dear players,

There are only a few days left to finish the campaign and we want to show you more details about the incredible “Most Wanted Ghost” reward. It would be great if you don't miss the opportunity to be eternal in Eden Genesis.

notes.title: What is the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward in Eden Genesis?

items.text: During the game, Leah will get access to the Eden Genesis central system where the data of the most wanted and dangerous Ghosts on the network is stored. High-ranking hackers whose reward would grant millions to anyone offering information about them. Thanks to this reward you will be one of these Ghosts, becoming part of the game and its story.

notes.title: How is the “Most Wanted Ghost” card created?

items.text: Our team will ask you for an image of yourself or even a pet, as well as characteristics of the image, references or details that allow us to create together a memorable Ghost file. Since a picture says more than a thousand words, here are some examples.

They look amazing, right? Well, it is only possible to be a Ghost in Eden Genesis and become part of our game forever through the “Most Wanted Ghost” reward, whether in its Early or Standard mode. You will also get a Collector's Edition and the digital version of the game, besides the soundtrack and other stuff…
There are only a few days left... We rely on your support to reach the next stretch goal and make Eden Genesis an even better game with your contribution.
See Now Reward "Most Wanted Ghost"
We are preparing more news for the upcoming days, so stay tuned because the last few days will be frantic.

Easy Anti Cheat has been removed
Aeternum Game Studios has decided to remove the EAC feature from Aeterna Noctis to ensure full accessibility to players and also in response to the demands of the community.

We understand that the addition of this functionality has not been well-received by certain sectors, and has also posed a problem for those players who for accessibility reasons have not been able to enjoy the title.

Instead, we have designed our own anti-cheat system that only applies to the leaderboards of the timed trials. This way, the stats obtained will remain legitimate without affecting the rest of the content of Aeterna Noctis, that is, gameplay elements and features that are single-player.

We have always listened to the community. This has been one of our hallmarks as a dev team. It is thanks to your suggestions that the Aeterna Universe has never stopped including improvements based on player feedback. The message was clear, EAC was an addition that was not liked and now it is history.

We would be very grateful if, just as you have expressed your disagreement with the inclusion of EAC, now that it has been removed from the title, you would also share it on the Steam forum and the rest of the networks, so that the news reaches all players. We trust that this decision will allow Aeterna Noctis to be valued solely for its playable values.
Long live the King of Darkness!

releases.displayName: New patch featuring a new game mode!

items.text: New patch featuring a new game mode!
Aeterna Mode: new game mode with redesigned platforms and puzzles for a more accessible experience focused on action and exploration
Noctis Mode: the studio original version: The patch is available now on Steam, Epic Games Store and PlayStation 5! It will be ready for Xbox Series in two days, the platform must approve it first.
